needs.proposedSignature: `levelUp?: { cost: ManaCost }` on CardDef (claiming the printed `Level up {cost}` line), a `level` counter the ability adds, `levelBands?: [{ from: number; to?: number; power: number; toughness: number; abilities: Ability[] }]` claiming the `LEVEL a-b` and `p/t` lines, and a condition `{ kind: 'level-counters-ge'; value: number }`
needs.semantics: CR 711: 'Level up [cost]' is a sorcery-speed activated ability that puts a level counter on the permanent; while the number of level counters falls inside a printed LEVEL band the creature has that band's power/toughness (a layer-7b characteristic-setting effect) and that band's abilities, replacing the ones below it. This is a DIFFERENT mechanic from CR 716 Class levels, which set-level / self-level / became-level already model — a Class level is a designation raised one step at a time, a leveler's level is a counter count. The `LEVEL 1-4` and `1/2` band lines reach a script as separate oracle lines and need declarations of their own to be claimed.
